rubric.evidence: Upgrade corrected the previous revision's core claim ('the same policy now applies to workers spawned by that page'): the explainer's proposed solution, read in full 2026-09-27, makes the worker script's OWN response header authoritative for network workers ('any creator policy is ignored (no merge/intersection)') with inheritance only for blob:/data:. Header ABNF quoted verbatim from the draft §7.2.1; flag name corrected from the generic experimental-web-platform-features label to the actual DocumentPolicyInDedicatedWorker runtime feature (verified experimental in runtime_enabled_features.json5).
Feature 6242687411945472 appears under 'In developer trial (Behind a flag)' in the milestone=147 listing; route and identity unchanged by the upgrade.

Three inventory items (the header as read from worker responses, the network-worker source algorithm, the local-scheme clone) with nine-dimension mappings; the explainer's shared/service-worker semantics are summarized as proposal scope, explicitly not claimed as shipped Chrome 147 behavior.

Leads with the counter-intuitive practical rule (opting in your page does NOT opt in its workers), then the per-scheme table, then the explainer's rationale (cross-origin leakage, origin control, overhead) in its own section.

Server-header + worker-Profiler example uses the explainer's own quoted snippet with the serving requirement spelled out; live worker-feature-probe showcase demo embedded with four siblings linked. Examples source-derived, not executed.

Honest empty-compat handling: MDN 404s and the missing BCD http/headers file are stated as verified absences, every row is labelled interim ChromeStatus data, and runtime probe guidance (typeof Profiler inside the worker) replaces sniffing.

Every named source is linked: draft §7.2.1 anchor, whatwg/html PR 12026, HTML policy-container dfn, explainer, both explainers in see-also, chromestatus record + listing, runtime flag file, crbug, intent thread resolved from the record's msgid redirect, showcase routes HEAD-checked 200 on 2026-09-27. The Firefox/Safari no-signal views carry no public URL on the record and the page says so.
Single h1, sequential h2 outline with anchor ids, banner role=note with aria-label, warn-block with visible label, iframe title + figcaption, thead rows on all tables.
House overflow protections applied (overflow-wrap, .table-wrap, pre overflow-x, iframe max-width); verified via the repo responsive matrix (mobile+desktop screenshots read 2026-09-27).

Five CPS concept routes exist; worker-feature-probe embedded (probes the policy-gated feature from inside a worker, the page's central point), the other four linked; feature route recorded in conformance.json's cpsFeature.
